title: Render402
mainTitle: Generate MiniMax H3 video with one x402 payment
subtitle: Agent-ready AI video generation paid in USDC on Base
description:
## What it does

Render402 gives agents a direct x402-paid API for MiniMax H3 video generation. It supports text-to-video, reference-image video, first-and-last-frame animation, and audio-driven lip sync.

## Best for

- Agents that need to create video without managing a conventional API subscription.
- Automated media workflows that prefer exact per-request USDC payments.
- Text, image, frame, and lip-sync generation through one endpoint.

## Discovery

Read the public OpenAPI document, pricing schedule, model list, and capability matrix before paying. Submit a unique `Idempotency-Key`; the first request returns the exact x402 payment requirement, and the paid retry creates the generation job.
useCase: Use Render402 when an agent needs to generate a short AI video and pay per request in USDC on Base. Text-to-video can be called directly; image, frame, and lip-sync modes first use the public upload flow to obtain asset IDs.

zh-CN.title: Render402

zh-CN.description:
## 能做什么

Render402 为 Agent 提供直接通过 x402 付费的 MiniMax H3 视频生成 API，支持文生视频、参考图生视频、首尾帧动画和音频驱动口型同步。

## 适合场景

- 不想管理传统 API 订阅、需要生成视频的 Agent。
- 希望使用 USDC 按次精确支付的自动化媒体工作流。
- 通过一个端点完成文本、图片、首尾帧和口型同步生成。

## 发现与调用

支付前先读取公开的 OpenAPI 文档、价格表、模型列表和能力矩阵。提交唯一的 `Idempotency-Key`；第一次请求会返回准确的 x402 支付要求，携带支付证明重试后创建生成任务。
zh-CN.useCase: 当 Agent 需要生成短视频并在 Base 上使用 USDC 按次支付时调用 Render402。文生视频可直接调用；图片、首尾帧和口型同步模式需先通过公开上传流程取得素材 ID。

endpoints.title: Generate AI Video
endpoints.subtitle: Create text, image, frame, or lip-sync video
endpoints.description: Create a MiniMax H3 video generation job after exact x402 payment. Price is calculated from duration, resolution, and whether uploaded media is referenced. The accepted response includes status and output URLs for polling and retrieval.
endpoints.useCase: Call this endpoint after selecting a supported generation mode from the public capability matrix and preparing any required image or audio assets.
